page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 81 at right. Main text in one column, from "non parum" to "(vbi lubet)", with a catchword-line "G" and "ac-|" at the foot. A narrow margin on the right holds one note, "Xiphil. Epit. Dionis." beside the text, plus faint marks.

main_text.p: non parum reluctantibus θεῶν μετὰ συξκὸς ἐχθρὰ: At sunt inimicitiæ quædam intestinæ, quæque se nunquam exerant. Ecce vim publicam, ὑπὸ ἀνθρώπων τυράννων: At parebit fortasse aliquando; Nec illud; ἡ ἀλλαγή: Ecce rebellem usque Deo condicionem: Quæ hîc ad bonum propensio est? Quæ exequendi potestas? Sacrificent sibimet (quod Seianus olim solitus erat) si volunt, Pontificij: Ruat profecto cœlum; nos ista nobis arrogare quæ Deo soli sacra quadam ἐκκοινωνία competere deprehenduntur, nec audemus, nec possumus. Tutum quidem est Pontificijs ad nos (vbi lubet)Xiphil. Epit. Dionis.
[Greek marginal fragments as printed; the largest illegible in this scan.]

page.notes: The Greek words in the text are approximations of the printed Greek; several are damaged. Faint show-through and stains on the right margin were left out. The catchword "ac-" is a hyphenated word-break at the foot.
